label: Areas
description: Manages application navigation areas, their menus and routes, and global menu definitions.

xshell:area:change.description: Emitted on the Bus when navigation changes the current area.

areaId.description: Identifier of the newly selected area.

xshell:menus:change.description: Emitted on the Bus when a registered dynamic menu source refreshes and changes its menu items.

getAreas.description: Returns the array of configured navigation areas.

getArea.description: Returns the area with the specified ID, or null if it is unknown.

getDefaultArea.description: Returns the default area, falling back to the first area, or null.

getCurrentArea.description: Returns the currently selected area or the default area.

resolveAreaId.description: Resolves an area ID from an href using the longest matching area prefix; returns null when no area matches.

resolvePath.description: Finds a menu item by its public path across all areas, or returns null.

resolveHref.description: Finds the menu item for an href in the specified area or an area inferred from the target/current context.

parameters.name: areaId
parameters.description: Optional area ID; null uses context-based resolution.

getModuleId.description: Extracts the module ID from a URL containing the configured module-assets base path, or returns null.

getMenus.description: Returns all effective menu arrays for an area, or an empty array.

getMenu.description: Returns the named effective menu for an area, or an empty array.

getMenuitemBreadcrumb.description: Returns the ordered menu-item breadcrumb for an href in an area, or null.

registerSource.description: Registers a dynamic menu source with resolve() and optional dependsOn events; installs a refresh() method on the source.

getGlobalMenu.description: Returns the named global menu or null.
